overview: The Committee of the Whole met to receive and discuss a presentation on the draft findings of the Affordable Housing Linkage Nexus Study report.

items.title: Affordable Housing Linkage Nexus Study Report Presentation
items.summary: The Committee of the Whole received a presentation on the draft study, which recommended implementing a flat linkage fee of $5 to $8 per square foot for non-residential developments over 10,000 square feet to fund affordable housing. Council members discussed how the proposed fee might affect economic competitiveness and developer viability, but took no formal legislative action.

subject: Affordable Housing Linkage Nexus Study
